name: Vessia Drun

poster.hook: Tribune Torvak Drun, last seen entering a furnace, 1064. Kin still asking.

story.appearance: Tall red-scaled dragonborn with a chipped left horn and a legion-issue shield worn bare at the rim. Her Pyrosi armour is mended in four different thread colours and kept spotless anyway.
story.concept: Vessia served twelve years as a Pyrosi legion optio and left with a pension, a bad knee and one ambition: to stand in front of the furnace door beneath the Thermae of the Quiet Hand on the night it opens. Her grandfather Torvak volunteered to be the Surety of the Cooling Concord before she was born. She grew up on his letters, which stopped arriving before she could read them.
story.stake: Tonight the binding lapses. Her grandfather will be renewed, released or ruined, and for the first time in her life she has a vote in which.
story.goal: Bring Torvak out of the fire alive, or at least hear him say what he wants.
story.secret: Three weeks ago a Black Ash legion officer offered her a centurion's honours and a pyre for Torvak if she told them the hour and the route. She gave both. She carries the ash-black coin that calls them in. She truly believes they mean to free him.
story.voice: Clipped, parade-ground plain. Says 'noted' when she disagrees. Counts off under her breath in Pyrosi marching tallies when she is trying not to feel something.
mannerisms: Comes to attention whenever someone says 'Tribune'
Warms her hands at every fire she passes, then pulls them back as if burned
Thumbs the rim of her shield when she lies
story.trinket: Torvak's last letter, scorched at one edge and unreadable below the third line

ties.text: Sabra tends her grandfather's shrine and has read her his words, or said she has. Vessia is not sure whether the priestess is loyal to the man or the altar.
Every Jubilee for six years the stoker has let her sit on the bench outside the furnace door. Vessia has never said thank you and knows it.
ties.public: Tamsin lets her sit by the furnace door each Jubilee

ties.text: His grandfather drafted the clause that bound hers. She has rehearsed what she will say to him for twenty years and still has not decided whether it is 'thank you' or a punch.
ties.public: His grandfather's clause bound hers; they have not spoken

story.intro: "Optio Vessia Drun, retired. My grandfather is in that furnace. Noted that you have views. Walk with me."

features.name: Draconic Ancestry (Red)
features.text: Your breath and your resistance both use fire.

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.text: Replace one attack in an Attack action with a 15-ft cone of fire: Dex save or 1d10 fire damage, half on a success. DC 12.

features.name: Savage Attacker
features.text: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, roll its damage dice twice and use either total.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: Bonus Action: regain 1d10 + 4 HP. One use returns on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: Take one additional action on your turn (not the Magic action).

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.text: When you fail an ability check, spend a Second Wind use to add 1d10; if it still fails, the use is not spent.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.text: Four d8 superiority dice, regained on a Short or Long Rest; one maneuver per attack. Maneuvers: Goading Attack (Wis save, target has disadvantage against others), Parry (reaction: reduce melee damage by die + Str mod), Precision Attack (add die to an attack roll). Save DC 14.

features.name: Student of War
features.text: Proficiency with Smith's Tools and the History skill.

attacks.name: Breath Weapon
attacks.note: Replaces one attack; 2 uses per Long Rest

flashback: Which of your grandfather's letters did you learn by heart as a child, and which line in it did you never believe?

ifUnclaimed.npc: Vessia arrives late as a grim, bad-kneed NPC and reaches the furnace at the start of Act 4. She votes as the party leans, and after the vote she is the one who confesses that she gave the Black Ash the hour and the route.

reassign.text: With his granddaughter absent, the Registrar names you Torvak's proxy by oath-kinship, the Surety's blood in all but birth. You hold his vote tonight, and you owe him the truth about what he wants.

reassign.beat: The ash-black coin and the leaked hour
reassign.text: A Pyrosi envoy promised you Torvak would be freed, not used, if you gave them the hour the wards would fall and the pilgrims' route. You gave both. The ash-black coin in your pocket calls them in, and you truly believe they mean him no harm.

cuts: Vessia's defection choice in Act 3 (the Black Ash letter goes to whoever inherited the coin).
The Sabra and Vessia forgiveness subplot.
The 'thank you or a punch' conversation with Selenor.
